review.basis: Reviewed language transitions in frozen evidence_text and existing PDF-verified segments; pairing is not semantic equivalence.
review.language_policy: Language boundaries are materialized by the cleaner; corpus input sources are exclusively zh-Hant/en.
review.offset_convention: Unicode codepoints, zero-based, half-open, relative to evidence_text
review.shared_policy: Literal numbers, formulas, currencies and plan codes apply to each available language; embedded names and URLs retain the passage language.
